title: Grateful Dead Live at Mammoth Gardens on 1970-04-24
lineage: AUD > MR > Reel > DAT > Cool Edit Pro > CDR > SHN

ai_review.summary: Sub‑par audience recording with pitch and tracking issues, yet the Dark Star stands out as a highlight.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers criticize the sound quality – one calling it “sub par” and another noting a slower pitch, false starts and broken‑string flaws.  The performance itself is not heavily discussed, though the Dark Star receives specific praise.  Overall the tape is more of interest to completists than casual listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: Recording quality is consistently described as poor, dragging the overall rating down despite a positive mention of Dark Star; limited commentary on performance leads to a modest mixed score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Pitch appears slower than other shows, tracking flaws (false start, broken string), overall sound described as sub‑par and not great but not disastrous.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure or pacing were provided.
